# AutoLeave

**Category:** Combat  
**Aliases:** Auto Disconnect, Auto Log, AutoDisconnect, AutoLeave, AutoLog

## What it does

AutoLeave watches your health and pulls you off the server the moment things get dangerous. As soon as your health drops to or below the configured threshold, the module disconnects you automatically — handy on combat servers where a clutch escape is better than a death and the loot loss that comes with it.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/combat/autoleave). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
